title: Coachman’s House — Yasnaya Polyana

buildingCutout.basis: Coachman’s hut/Кучерская изба, way167382256, remains independent from Volkonsky House and the other estate houses. The exact mapped9.7m by5.5m four-sided outline fixes the axes: X northwest along the long face, Z northeast toward the photographed front approach.
